description.ncbi_summary: Enables dodecanoyl-[acyl-carrier-protein] hydrolase activity; myristoyl-[acyl-carrier-protein] hydrolase activity; and palmitoyl-[acyl-carrier-protein] hydrolase activity. Involved in medium-chain fatty acid biosynthetic process. Predicted to be located in cytosol. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Apr 2022]

uniprot_function.text: Contributes to the release of free fatty acids from fatty acid synthase (FASN). Has broad substrate specificity, giving rise to a range of free fatty acids with chain lengths between 10 and 16 carbon atoms (C10 - C16).
